new_results.statement: If |phi_Y(t)|<=min(1,K/|t|), then Q_Y(rho)<=c_E K rho[1+log(1/(K rho))] for K rho<=1 and sup_x E log_+(A/|Y-x|)<=Omega(KA), with c_E=1/[2 sin^2(1/2)] and exact piecewise Omega.

After an invertible indefinite physical pair with D=|det B| and kappa=sigma_min(B), any uniformly conditioned remainder envelope |phi|<=min(1,K/|t|) yields ||p_Q||inf<=inf_y{4 sqrt(K/(kappa y))+D^(-1/2)Omega(y)} with zero outside-support/fragment/moment tax.

For Schur bank Delta+lambda1 aa^T+lambda2 bb^T with arbitrary diagonal Delta, orthonormal a,b, max_i(a_i^2+b_i^2)<=1/2, P=|lambda1 lambda2|, arbitrary outside coupling and affine leakage, ||p_Q||inf<=inf_y{8 sqrt(pi) kappa^(-1/2)P^(-1/4)y^(-1/2)+D^(-1/2)Omega(y)}, hence <=8 sqrt(pi)kappa^(-1/2)P^(-1/4)+sin(1/2)^(-2)D^(-1/2).

For iid Uniform[-1/2,1/2], R=2XY has phi_R(t)=2Si(t/2)/t~pi/t and unbounded logarithmic density, yet the exact-target sum of two independent copies has density sup <=2. Requiring L1 Fourier/bounded density of each rank-two remainder is therefore an invalid proof interface.
